subject: rChart dimple plot displays correctly in IE and Firefox. Not Chrome

messages.author: a04dd210a2616359
messages.subject: rChart dimple plot displays correctly in IE and Firefox. Not Chrome
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm not a web developer but I know that there are some background code differences between the web browsers, which might explain the following. 

I'm trying to figure out why the dimple plot on my shiny app displays properly in IE and Firefox, but not in chrome. The order of the bars in the "Movement between School Types" and "Movement between Job Categories" tabs are totally random in chrome (e.g. 2002, 2007, 2010, etc.). I was very confused because everything displayed when I deployed the app locally. Out of desperation I tried to open the app in IE and it worked correctly, displaying exactly like my local deployment.  Anyone know what is going on and how I can fix the app to work properly in all browsers?

https://amenzel.shinyapps.io/Folsom/

Thanks,
Andy

This sounds like a problem with rCharts. My recommendation would be to reach out to the shiny discussion list, or perhaps reach out to the rCharts folks on GitHub.

-Andy
